description: Runtime State Mapping - 基于B9P8 final_state_projection_manifest

androidEmbeddedRuntimeState.note: A线已有的Android嵌入运行时状态机 (NOT_INSTALLED, INSTALLED, STARTING, READY...)
androidEmbeddedRuntimeState.authority: A线专有 (不属于B12 Kernel Runtime)
androidEmbeddedRuntimeState.rule: B12 不重复实现此状态机

rules.rule2: Provider health属于Domain Provider Health，由Adapter/Provider内部管理
rules.rule3: 不同Platform Provider状态 (Android ready, iOS unavailable) 属于Domain Provider Health
rules.rule4: Runtime lifecycle继续挂接现有Supervisor/Host体系
rules.rule5: Adapter无独立状态事实源 (最多health/ready，由Provider派生)
